prompts.title: Consult script
prompts.summary: A 30-minute consult that ends in a plan and a clear price, without pressure.
prompts.prompt: Write a 30-minute consult script for [my business]. Sections: welcome (2 min), goals in their words (8), training history and injuries, with a note to get a doctor's OK where needed (5), schedule (3), the plan I'd suggest (5), packages and prices [ ] (5), next step (2). Questions to ask in each. No promises about results.
prompts.use: Print it. Write their answers on it.

prompts.title: Weekly check-ins
prompts.summary: Short weekly texts for week one, the middle of a package and the last two sessions.
prompts.prompt: Write short check-in texts from [trainer] for: the first week, the middle of a package, two sessions left (with the renewal option), and after a missed session. Under 35 words each, warm, one question.

prompts.title: Session packages
prompts.summary: Builds three packages from your hourly rate, with the renewal price.
prompts.prompt: Build three personal training packages. My rate per session [$], sessions per week options [ ], package lengths [ ]. Give names, prices, what's included, a renewal price, and the cancellation rule in one line.
prompts.use: Put them on your site and your consult sheet.

hooks: Trainers: sell the package, not the session.

A tip post that isn't medical advice.
Track sessions left, not just sessions done.
